claims.question: Q1
claims.answer: Since note 0014 is the more recent document and reflects the migration to RFC 9110, Retry-After should always be a plain integer number of seconds. HTTP-date is deprecated.

claims.question: Q2
claims.answer: RFC 9110 now defines 429 Too Many Requests, consolidating the older status code RFCs into one document.

claims.question: Q3
claims.answer: Yes, a 429 response can include Retry-After.
